plugins.name: crewlore
plugins.description: The /lore skill and hooks for crewlore, which reads the sessions your coding agents already produce, and your repo's pull requests, and writes the decisions, procedures and gotchas into a plain-text knowledge book inside your repo, each entry quoting the line it came from and recording whether the team adopted it or tried it and declined. Runs the `lore` command: pipx install crewlore first.
